MODEL_HP0_DELAY_TAG := $(subst =,_,$(addprefix -,$(filter BP_AXI_RESPONSE_DELAY=%,$(DEFINES))))
# Capture is an ifdef-selected hardware mode: even MACRO=0 enables it.
MODEL_ICACHE_DEMAND_CAPTURE_TAG := $(if $(filter BP_ICACHE_REPLAY_DEMAND_CAPTURE BP_ICACHE_REPLAY_DEMAND_CAPTURE=%,$(DEFINES)),-icapture,)
# Payload geometry changes both arrays and generated control. Include the
# effective defines even when a design receives them through EXTRA_DEFINES.
MODEL_RETAINED_TAG := $(subst $(bsg_var_space),,$(foreach retained_def,$(filter BP_RETAINED_%,$(DEFINES)),-$(subst =,_,$(retained_def))))
# Verification scope is part of executable identity too. Presence selects the
# BSG guard even when a caller spells BSG_HIDE_FROM_SYNTHESIS=0.
MODEL_ASSERTION_TAG := $(if $(filter --assert,$(VERILATOR) $(VV_BUILD_OPTS) $(BUILD_ARGS)),-assert,)$(if $(filter BSG_HIDE_FROM_SYNTHESIS BSG_HIDE_FROM_SYNTHESIS=%,$(DEFINES)),-bsgsimhidden,)$(if $(strip $(VERILATOR_SUPPORT_SOURCES)),-support,)
MODEL_CONFIG_TAG := nt$(NUM_THREADS)-nc$(NUM_CONTEXTS)-cfg$(CFG)-trace$(if $(TRACE),1,0)$(MODEL_PREFETCH_BANK_TAG)$(MODEL_PREFETCH_ELS_TAG)$(MODEL_AXI_MEM_TAG)$(MODEL_HP0_DELAY_TAG)$(MODEL_ICACHE_DEMAND_CAPTURE_TAG)$(MODEL_RETAINED_TAG)$(MODEL_ASSERTION_TAG)
MODEL_CONFIG_STAMP := obj_dir/.build_config-$(MODEL_CONFIG_TAG)
